subject: prd/implement-now
statement: If a plan/v2 projected task is missing any frozen demand field, differs from the frozen plan, contains an unknown semantic value, or contains native dispatch data, then the system shall refuse the task before claim and identify the carrier, field, expected value or vocabulary, and remedy
intent: task remains unclaimed with a plan-boundary integrity error
fit_criterion: one fixture per missing/changed/unknown/native class performs zero claims and names every offending field; mixed task sets continue only independent valid tasks
